proposal.title: Add mandatory primary cashtag requirement in creator prompt for Write-to-Earn monetization attribution
proposal.reason: Binance Write-to-Earn reward tracking relies on primary cashtags (e.g. $BTC, $TRUMP) to attribute eligible content engagement. Updating the multi-agent system prompt ensures generated drafts naturally incorporate the tradeable asset's cashtag for monetization attribution while preserving human-like writing standards.
